label: prop:spectral-chart-correspondence
title: Spectral--chart correspondence: Hecke eigenspaces realise the chart-glue of $\mathbb{P}_q(V)$
html: The Hecke spectral decomposition of V \otimes V directly specifies the chart-transition data on the projective line \mathbb{P}(V). On the two contact affine charts, the transition coordinate \kappa in z\,w = \kappa equals \lambda_+^{-1} = -\lambda_- = q^{-1}. The single scalar identity dictating the antisymmetric eigenvalue simultaneously fixes the geometric gluing of the quantum projective line.
